title: LIAR GAME

opinions.point: Viewers broadly enjoyed the episode and considered it a strong season finale, especially praising its surprises and strategic mind games.
Many commenters highlighted Nao's growth, increased competence, and continued kindness as a major strength.
The cast and character interactions were frequently praised for being funny, engaging, and emotionally satisfying.
The voice performance and distinctive delivery of one antagonist received enthusiastic approval.
Several viewers found the games clever and distinctive, while noting that some tactics could be difficult to follow or occasionally predictable.
Animation quality and production budget were criticized as weak.
Some viewers felt the early pacing was slower than ideal, despite enjoying the overall series.

notes: The title and episode label directly match LIAR GAME episode 26. The page exposed the thread and comments, but did not expose reliable score or total-comment metadata, so those fields are 0. Comment sentiment is paraphrased and spoiler-free.
